title: Returns, refunds and order cancellations
html:
Two ways we can help. If you chose the wrong size or changed your mind, our voluntary return offer covers unused items in their original packaging.

Contact us within 30 calendar days after delivery and send the item back within 14 calendar days after your request. Items must be unused, in their original packaging, with any tags attached. There are no product-specific exclusions, except that a plant that has clearly been repotted or pruned counts as used. We show any final-sale restriction on the item page before you buy.

If your order arrived damaged, contained the wrong item, or differed from its description, email PumpCadle668@outlook.com with the order number and a description. A photo helps. We will explain the remedy available and how to return the item if needed. The change-of-mind conditions above apply only to voluntary returns. You keep any rights provided by law.

Starting a return

Email PumpCadle668@outlook.com with the order number, the item and quantity, and the email used at checkout. If you cannot find the order number, give the purchaser's name and approximate order date. We will send mailing instructions. The return destination is 36 W Michigan Ave, Battle Creek, MI 49017, USA. Use the address in those instructions.

Return costs and exchanges

For a change-of-mind return the customer pays return postage. There is no label charge and no restocking fee. The original shipping charge is refunded only where the whole order is returned because of our error. If the issue is our error, contact us before paying to ship it back so we can arrange the return. To exchange an item, tell us which item and size you want and we will hold it while the return travels.

What your refund covers

We calculate a voluntary refund from the amount paid for the returned item, accounting for discounts, applicable tax and the postage described above. If you return part of a discounted order, the confirmation identifies the amount attributed to the returned item, and we explain any deduction. Keep your carrier receipt until the return is resolved.

We issue eligible voluntary refunds to the original payment method within 5 business days of receipt of the returned item, and send confirmation when we issue the credit. Your bank may post it later. If the credit is missing, send the order number so we can confirm the amount, issue date and any transaction reference.

Cancelling an order

To stop or change an order before it ships, contact PumpCadle668@outlook.com. We can make changes until dispatch. If the carrier already has your parcel we will explain the return options. If we cannot ship when promised, you may choose a prompt refund for the unshipped order.

Membership

This store has no paid membership, so cancellations of a plan do not arise. Only products are charged.
